create_run: create a Sacred Run by initializing scaffolding, config, logging, and seeding from an experiment
create_scaffolding: create an OrderedDict of Scaffold objects from an experiment and its sorted ingredients
initialize_logging: initialize logging for all scaffolds in the experiment and return root and run loggers
gather_ingredients_topological: gather and topologically sort an experiment's ingredients by deepest dependency depth
get_command: get the main command function from scaffolding by its dotted command path
